_note: Families may override match.claim with their own "match" key.

when.start: in the first four shots of a rally
when.late: after the 12th shot of a rally

reply.claim.bottom: {He} answers a smash with {reply} less than most pros
reply.phrase.top: answers a smash with {reply} more than most

zone.claim.top: {He} hits from the {where} more than most pros
zone.claim.bottom: {He} hits from the {where} less than most pros
zone.phrase.top: hits from the {where} more than most
zone.phrase.bottom: hits from the {where} less than most

tempo.claim.top: {He} plays at a slower pace than most pros
tempo.claim.bottom: {He} plays at a faster pace than most pros
tempo.phrase.top: slows the game down more than most

serveShort.claim.top: {He} serves short more than most pros
serveShort.claim.bottom: {He} serves long more than most pros

band.phrase.strength: wins {band} rallies more often than most pros
band.match: Won {value} of rallies of {length}, vs {usual} in {his} other matches.

smashWins.claim.strength: {His} smashes win the point more often than most pros'
smashWins.phrase.strength: wins the point off {his} smash more often than most
smashWins.of: of {his} smashes won the point straight away
smashWins.match: Won the point straight after {value} of {his} smashes, vs {usual} in {his} other matches.
